feed.title: NPR Topics: World
feed.subtitle: International news, global reporting and analysis from NPR. Plus dispatches from NPR’s State of the World podcast.

entry.title: The U.N.'s top court rules Myanmar committed genocide against the Rohingya
entry.summary: The International Court of Justice found that Myanmar security forces "acted with genocidal intent" against the Rohingya during military operations in the northern Rakhine state in 2017.

entry.title: Anthropic raises more than $100B in IPO. And, Dems nominate Jeffries for House speaker
entry.summary: Despite growing concern over a possible AI bubble, Anthropic had a record-breaking initial public offering. And, Hakeem Jeffries could become the first Black Speaker of the House.

entry.title: Iran's attacks on ships in the Strait of Hormuz escalate
entry.summary: Iran takes the offensive with attacks on ships in the Strait of Hormuz and airstrikes on several countries around the Persian Gulf.

entry.title: Trump, Xi and Putin meet as global alliances hang in the balance
entry.summary: President Trump, China's Xi Jinping and Russia's Vladimir Putin have gathered in Shenzhen, China, for a historic trilateral meeting, with Ukraine, Iran and nuclear disarmament on the agenda.

entry.title: Karl Kani dressed hip-hop royalty for decades. Now he's telling his own story
entry.summary: On NPR's Morning Edition, fashion designer Karl Kani talks about his new memoir, dressing some of hip-hop's biggest stars and why skinny jeans aren't for everyone.

entry.title: Mary Peltola flips Alaska's Senate seat. And, Nvidia won't reinstate Jensen Huang
entry.summary: Former Democratic Rep. Mary Peltola has won one of the U.S.' most watched Senate races. And, Nvidia's board says it doesn't plan to reinstate former CEO Jensen Huang despite pressure from his allies.

entry.title: Trump to meet with Russia's Putin and China's Xi for historic joint meeting
entry.summary: President Trump will meet with Russian President Vladimir Putin and Chinese President Xi on Thursday for a historic three-way meeting.

entry.title: Former U.S. ambassador on Trump's joint summit with leaders of China and Russia
entry.summary: NPR's Leila Fadel speaks to Nicholas Burns, former U.S. ambassador to China and NATO, about President Trump's planned meeting with the leaders of China and Russia.

entry.title: Greetings from a Berlin square, where an artist's statue watches over children at play
entry.summary: Children frolic around the ever-watchful and calm Käthe Kollwitz cast in bronze, in a square named after the German artist, whose work often depicted children in the wake of World War I.

entry.title: Trump lands in China with key meetings with Xi and Putin on the agenda
entry.summary: Xi paid Trump a special honor by greeting him on the tarmac after Air Force One arrived in Shenzhen, reciprocating a gesture made by the U.S. president during Xi's visit to Washington in September.
